# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech to Build Something](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal essay about quitting a tech job to pursue independent projects and life ambitions.

## Other

- [Claude Surf AI Development Tool](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): AI-powered orchestrator for autonomous software development using Claude agents and Linear integration
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice note on color wheels, harmony schemes, perceptual color spaces, and design principles.
- [History of Martian Ideas](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canal theories to modern spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container's Impact](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized containers revolutionized global trade, displaced dock workers, and enabled modern globalization.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Comprehensive guide to sourdough fermentation, microbiology, and baking chemistry explained clearly.
- [Ancient Eclipse Predicting Device](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator from 150 BCE that predicted eclipses and tracked astronomical cycles.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Mechanisms](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through sensory and sensorimotor phases, critical periods, and neural feedback loops.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Why every flat map distorts Earth, what projections preserve, and why Web Mercator dominates online maps.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores cold light chemistry, deep-sea camouflage strategies, and bioluminescent organisms' evolutionary innovations.
- [Pokémon's Origins and Development](https://www.justinhe.com/x): How a Tokyo bug collector's childhood inspired the world's highest-grossing media franchise through six years of development.
- [Competitive Pokémon Metagame](https://www.justinhe.com/y): How players built a complex competitive ruleset through datamining hidden mechanics and community consensus.
- [Pokémon Red Blue Generation One Glitches](https://www.justinhe.com/z): Exploration of famous bugs that shaped Pokémon Gen 1, including MissingNo., the unreachable truck, and the Mew glitch.
